## About
B J & M Auto is a woman owned and operated business. We repair and maintain all kinds of vehicles, from everyday cars to vans, buses, EMS vehicles, tractors and bucket trucks.
We are also a licensed state inspection center, emission repair facility and diesel inspection facility, serving Elizabeth and the Tri-State area. We run our own tow truck and use current computer diagnostic equipment to work with today's vehicles.
Neighbors give us 4.7 from 90 Google reviews, and a lot of them mention friendly, honest people who explain the work clearly.

## Services
- NJ state inspections: State inspections for your car or truck. ($76.50)
- Smoke inspections ($56.50)
- DOT inspections ($45.00)
- Engine repair: Engine work on both diesel and gas vehicles.
- Transmissions
- Clutch, brakes and rear end repair
- Front end work and alignment
- Tire mounting and balancing
- Specialized vehicle upfitting

## FAQ
Q: When is the best time to come in?
A: We can get busy. One reviewer suggests coming in the morning to cut down on the wait.

Q: Does my diesel truck need a smoke inspection?
A: Diesel trucks over 18,000 lbs GVW are required to have one.

Q: Who needs a DOT inspection?
A: DOT inspections apply to vehicles over 8,000 lbs that do not get state inspected.
